{{Quote|I've collected every story I can find about Rogue Squadron and want to put together a history of the unit. I know all of the pilots' profiles, how many kills they had, where they came from&hellip;|Keevy Spart to [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Keevy Spart''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. He was slender, freckled, had short red hair, and resembled [[Kirtan Loor]].

==Biography==
Spart had been fascinated by tales of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] as a child and wished to be one. He applied to join the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]], but was deemed not skilled enough. He went to tech school and learned to be a [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]], but by the time he graduated the crisis was over and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] demobilized. He then tried to become a civilian pilot for [[Tinta Lines]], but as of [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] had had no success.

He later developed a hobby of trying to assemble all known facts on [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], its membership, its equipment, and its kills. While doing this project, he unknowingly was seated next to [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] on the shuttle ''[[Tinta Blue Seven]]'' when it was boarded by pirates working with the [[Invids]]. After Corran, masquerading as [[Jenos Idanian]], fought off and incapacitated the two would-be raiders, Spart navigated as Horn flew the shuttle away from [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Leonia Tavira]]'s Star Destroyer ''[[Invidious]]''.

After their escape, the two took the shuttle to [[Elshandruu Pica]] to meet up with [[Booster Terrik]] aboard his Star Destroyer ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]''. Keevy became ecstatic at being on the "ship that won the [[Battle of Thyferra]]," as he put it. Due to his skills at navigation, Booster hired Keevy on as the ''Venture''{{'s}} navigator.
